attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Changes the shared base BuildPrefix logic in SectionDisplayDriver, altering form-field prefix generation for every settings section site-wide (not just the six explicitly updated), which could silently break model binding for any third-party module's custom section driver that doesn't override BuildPrefix or relies on the old prefix format."}

reason: Changes the shared base BuildPrefix logic in SectionDisplayDriver, altering form-field prefix generation for every settings section site-wide (not just the six explicitly updated), which could silently break model binding for any third-party module's custom section driver that doesn't override BuildPrefix or relies on the old prefix format.
